name: ModelVariant107Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant107us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a star burst flashes and fades at a model part, eight textured sprites fly out from the part on looping timers, a beam of quads then grows from the part towards the camera axis, and two spinning squares pulse at the end); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 4 until the beam's rise time before the end, 1 for the rest of the duration and 2 after it; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-124 and 254 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
